name: Regulatory Reporting Agent
headline: Make reporting gaps reviewable before an authorized filing
pitch: Bring synthetic report status, source-quality exceptions, filing-state evidence, and audit findings into one regulatory brief while leaving certification, signature, and transmission to authorized owners.
why_try: A reporting lead can ask what is overdue or incomplete and receive the exact report, evidence gap, owner, and approval boundary.
customer_challenge: Regulatory data, completion status, validation evidence, and audit findings live across systems, slowing preparation and obscuring who must resolve each issue.
microsoft_ai_story: Microsoft Copilot Studio can provide the governed front door; approved regulatory data, a controlled reporting workspace, SharePoint, Teams, and a separately authorized filing connector can support production use.
business_value: Improves visibility into overdue reports and source-quality exceptions.
Creates a consistent audit-readiness handoff with named evidence and owners.
Preserves regulatory accountability by separating preparation from certification and filing.
business_flow: Compliance managers, regulatory reporting leads, data analysts, and internal auditors
Approved filing connector and Microsoft Teams

capabilities.name: Reporting portfolio status
capabilities.purpose: Summarizes synthetic deadlines, completion, quality, filing state, and ownership.

capabilities.name: Source-data validation screening
capabilities.purpose: Identifies incomplete or below-threshold synthetic source evidence before certification.

capabilities.name: Read-only filing-state tracker
capabilities.purpose: Shows recorded submission state without signing, certifying, or transmitting a filing.

capabilities.name: Audit evidence triage
capabilities.purpose: Organizes open findings and severity without predicting an audit outcome or providing legal advice.

capabilities.name: Quarterly emissions summary
capabilities.purpose: Consolidates synthetic quarterly pollutant totals against annual permit limits across all facilities.

capabilities.name: Draft EPA submission package
capabilities.purpose: Prepares a draft CAMD submission file and lists compliance risks without uploading or filing anything.
